turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress to floor]
    C --> D[Name evaporated content]
    D --> E[Locate operative sentence]
    E --> F[Report ratio, erosion, and flags]
    F --> G[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    G --> H[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt| I{Mode stated or inferable?}
    I -->|No| J[Ask for mode]
    J --> K[Wait for answer]
    K --> I

    I -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| L[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    L --> M{Floor passes?}
    M -->|No| N{How many gaps?}
    N -->|Three or fewer| O[Ask one question]
    N -->|Four or more| P[Ask three largest questions]
    P --> Q[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
    O --> K
    Q --> K

    M -->|Yes| R[Compress the prompt]
    R --> S{Cut removed specification?}
    S -->|Yes| T[Revert destructive cut]
    T --> R
    S -->|No| U{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    U -->|No| V{Floor still passes?}
    V -->|Yes| R
    V -->|No| W[Return last passing version]
    U -->|Yes| X[Contract is minimal]
    W --> Y[Output contract]
    X --> Y
    Y --> Z{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    Z -->|Keep negotiating| R
    Z -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| AA{Execution tools available?}
    AA -->|No| AB[Gate stays closed]
    AA -->|Yes| AC[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    AC --> AD{Result}
    AD -->|Success| AE[Done]
    AD -->|Floor item fails| AF[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    AF --> R
```
